title: Filing: Wise plans to debut on the Nasdaq as WSE, and relist in London for its secondary listing; Wise reports year-to-March net revenue up 19% YoY to $2.5B (Aisha S Gani/Bloomberg)
commentary: Wise at $2.5B revenue and 19% growth choosing Nasdaq over a pure London listing is a quiet indictment of European capital markets — the continent's most successful fintech still needs a US listing to get a proper valuation.
